# Tansift Production

> Video production, photography and social media content studio based in Essaouira, Morocco. Tansift makes brand films, Reels and short-form video, video podcasts, photography for brands, hotels and real estate, wedding films and drone footage, and supports visiting productions with local crew, location scouting and permit preparation. Languages: French, English, Darija, Arabic.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.tansiftproduction.com/): Who Tansift is and what it makes
- [Shoot in Essaouira](https://www.tansiftproduction.com/shoot-in-essaouira/): Local crew, locations, wind calendar, permits and FAQ for visiting productions
- [Services](https://www.tansiftproduction.com/services/): All services
- [Work](https://www.tansiftproduction.com/work/): Selected projects
- [Start a project](https://www.tansiftproduction.com/start-a-project/): Send a brief

## Services
- [Social media content](https://www.tansiftproduction.com/services/social-media-content/): Reels, TikToks and photo sets for Essaouira businesses
- [Video podcasts](https://www.tansiftproduction.com/services/podcast-production/): Multi-camera recording, full episodes and vertical clips
- [Photography](https://www.tansiftproduction.com/services/photography/): Brand, product, hospitality, real estate and portrait photography
- [Brand films](https://www.tansiftproduction.com/services/brand-films/): Brand films, commercials and corporate video
- [Weddings & events](https://www.tansiftproduction.com/services/weddings-and-events/): Wedding films and photos in Essaouira
- [Drone & aerial](https://www.tansiftproduction.com/services/drone-filming/): Aerial filming with permits prepared

## Guides
- [Film and drone permits in Morocco](https://www.tansiftproduction.com/journal/film-and-drone-permits-morocco/): CCM filming permit, drone authorisation and timelines
- [Essaouira light and wind: when to shoot](https://www.tansiftproduction.com/journal/essaouira-light-and-wind-when-to-shoot/): Trade wind season, best hours and locations
